'''Roff Volane''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]], who served in the military and attained the rank of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]]. During a conflict on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pleida]], he assigned a group of agents to escort the surgeon [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pleth Juun]] to the base [[Camp Kavel]], where a number of officers had been injured.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

==Personality and traits==
Volane had a lot of combat experience, which made him curt, cynical and humorless. However, despite this, he was highly respected by those who served with him.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
